title: Differential missingness

blocks.what_we_do: Test whether missing calls differ between cases and controls.
blocks.why: An overall high call rate can hide unequal missingness between outcome groups. Such a pattern can create spurious association if call failures correlate with genotype. A p-value measures how incompatible the observed group difference is with the equal-missingness model; it is not the probability that a site is an error. With many sites, some small p-values occur by chance. The course uses a prespecified screening cutoff of 0.00001.
blocks.you_need: State 4.1 and Disease phenotype joined at 2.7.
blocks.command:
```{r s4-2}
report <- guided_path(cfg, "4.2", "missing")
run_plink(cfg, c("--pfile", guided_path(cfg, "4.1"), "--test-missing", "--out", report))
x <- guided_table(paste0(report, ".missing"))
p <- as.numeric(x$P)
exclude <- guided_list(x$ID[!is.na(p) & p < 1e-5], guided_path(cfg, "4.2", "exclude.txt"))
run_plink(cfg, c("--pfile", guided_path(cfg, "4.1"), "--exclude", exclude, "--make-pgen", "--out", guided_path(cfg, "4.2")))
ops <- guided_replay_lists(cfg, "4.2", "4.1")
guided_register(cfg, "4.2", "4.1", 1844, 295439, operations = ops)
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

```sh
bin/plink2 --pfile results/guided/s4-1_state --test-missing --out results/guided/s4-2_missing --threads 2 --memory 2048
bin/plink2 --pfile results/guided/s4-1_state --exclude results/guided/s4-2_exclude.txt --make-pgen --out results/guided/s4-2_state --threads 2 --memory 2048
```

`--test-missing` compares missingness by binary phenotype. R selects IDs with p < 0.00001; `--exclude` applies that list. `--pfile` selects the native input; `--make-pgen` writes a new copy; `--out` names its files. The helper appends `--threads 2` and `--memory 2048` for threads and workspace MiB.
blocks.expected_result:
120 variants excluded; 295,439 variants and 1,844 samples remain.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks and instructor reference counts passed on Windows.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.what_this_check_can_reveal: Case/control-dependent calling, processing differences and some genotype-dependent missingness. A significant test does not itself identify the laboratory mechanism.
blocks.quick_check:
Can a variant pass the overall 98% call-rate rule and still fail this check?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

Yes. Its few missing calls can be concentrated in one phenotype group.

</details>
